name: Formative – Contact Form, Drag and Drop Custom Form Builder
author: Eunito

sections.description:
Formative is a feature-rich form builder plugin that makes creating and managing forms simple and efficient. With an intuitive drag-and-drop interface, you can build custom forms for any purpose without writing a single line of code.

Key Features

  • Drag and Drop Form Builder – Create forms effortlessly with an intuitive visual builder
  • User Form Submissions – Collect responses from your website visitors
  • Entry Management – View and manage all form submissions from the admin dashboard
  • Comprehensive Field Types – 20+ field types to build any form you need
  • Pre-built Templates – Ready to go with pre-built templates
  • Shortcode Support – Use shortcode anywhere of the post/page to show the form

Available Form Fields

  • Text – Single line text input
  • Email – Email address field with validation
  • Number – Numeric input field
  • Phone – Phone number field
  • Textarea – Multi-line text area
  • Select – Dropdown selection menu
  • Checkbox – Multiple choice checkboxes
  • Radio – Single choice radio buttons
  • Date – Date picker field
  • Time – Time picker field
  • URL – Website URL field with validation
  • Password – Secure password input
  • File Upload – Allow users to upload files
  • Rating – Star or numeric rating field
  • Range Slider – Slider for numeric values
  • Switch – Toggle switch field
  • reCAPTCHA – Spam protection with Google reCAPTCHA
  • First Name – Pre-configured first name field
  • Last Name – Pre-configured last name field
  • GDPR Consent – Checkbox for privacy compliance
  • Response Message – Display custom messages to users
  • Summary – Show form data summary
  • Submit Button – Customizable form submission button

Perfect For

  • Contact forms
  • Survey and polls
  • Feedback forms
  • Order forms
  • Application forms
  • Newsletter signups
  • And much more!

Why Choose Formative?

Formative combines ease of use with powerful functionality. Whether you’re creating a simple contact form or a complex form, Formative provides all the tools you need in one plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the formative folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Formative in your WordPress admin menu
  4. Start creating your first form using the drag-and-drop builder
  5. Add the form to any page or post using the provided shortcode
sections.faq:
How do I create a form?

After activating the plugin, go to the Formative menu in your WordPress dashboard. Click “Add New” and use the drag-and-drop builder to add fields to your form.

How do I add a form to my page?

Once you’ve created a form, you’ll receive a shortcode. Simply copy and paste this shortcode into any page, post, or widget where you want the form to appear.

Can I view form submissions?

Yes! All form submissions are stored in your WordPress database and can be viewed from the Formative entries section in your admin dashboard.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes, Formative includes a GDPR Consent field that you can add to your forms to ensure compliance with privacy regulations.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, Formative forms can be embedded using shortcodes, making them compatible with all major page builders including Elementor, Gutenberg, WPBakery, and more.
